definitions.explanation: A cup with graduated markings used to measure ingredients by volume, especially in cooking and baking.

examples.japanese: {計量|けいりょう}カップで{水|みず}を{量|はか}る。
examples.english: Measure water with a measuring cup.

examples.japanese: {計量|けいりょう}カップがないから、{目分量|めぶんりょう}で{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I didn't have a measuring cup, so I added it by eye.

examples.japanese: レシピ{通|どお}りに{計量|けいりょう}カップで{小麦粉|こむぎこ}を{二|に}カップ{量|はか}ってください。
examples.english: Please measure out two cups of flour with a measuring cup, as the recipe says.

notes:
Composed of {計量|けいりょう} (measuring) + カップ (cup). A standard kitchen tool in Japan. Note that the Japanese {一|いっ}カップ (one cup) in cooking is 200ml, which differs from the US cup (approximately 240ml).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計量|けいりょう}カップで{量|はか}る: measure with a measuring cup
- {計量|けいりょう}カップ{一杯|いっぱい}: one measuring cup full
- {耐熱|たいねつ}{計量|けいりょう}カップ: heat-resistant measuring cup

RELATED WORDS:
- {計量|けいりょう}スプーン: measuring spoon
- {大|おお}さじ: tablespoon (measurement)
- {小|こ}さじ: teaspoon (measurement)
- {目盛|めも}り: graduated markings; scale
